notes: Pushed by server immediately upon WebSocket connection and session initialization. Contains server capabilities, TLS certificate hash, ports, and domain feature flags.
Pushed immediately after serverinfo. Contains sanitized user profile, site rights, group links, and permissions.
Pushed on connect to site administrators if tracing is enabled on the domain. Enumerates debug logging sources.
Pushed on connect to site administrators if server has active warning items. Full array snapshot of server configuration warnings.
Pushed periodically when client views My Server tab. Contains server CPU/RAM usage, agent error counters, and session counts.
Client requests immediate server stats snapshot.
Client requests server timeline history stats. Server responds with action:servertimelinestats without echoing responseid or tag.
Carries events array representing server timeline history. Does not echo responseid.
Requests current, latest, and stable MeshCentral server versions from NPM.
Returns tags object with current, latest, stable version strings. Echoes responseid if provided in request.
Executes server console commands (info, args, cores, help, resetserver, etc.). Disallowed for loginToken sessions.
Returns console output string in value field, echoing responseid and tag.
Requests device list. Can filter by meshname or meshid, and supports pagination (skip/limit).
Returns dictionary of meshid -> array of node objects. Echoes responseid and tag if provided.
Requests list of all device groups visible to the user.
Returns array of meshes with rights. Does NOT return responseid; echoes tag: command.tag.
Requests all users list in current domain. Requires ManageUsers permission.
On success: returns users array with tag. Does NOT return responseid on success! Echoes responseid ONLY when access denied.
Requests user groups in current administrative domain.
Returns ugroups dictionary. Echoes tag: command.tag; does NOT return responseid.
Requests historical audit event log. Filters by nodeid or userid, with optional limit.
Returns events array. Echoes tag, nodeid, or userid; does NOT return responseid.
Requests list of recorded sessions on the server.
Returns recordings array. Echoes responseid and tag if provided.
Requests user files list in server storage.
Returns files object. Does NOT return responseid.
Requests login history for self or target user (requires site admin).
Returns events array. Does NOT return responseid or tag.
Requests current count of active WebSocket sessions per user.
Can arrive both as a direct response to query ({ action: "wssessioncount", wssessions: {...}, tag }) and as an event push ({ action: "event", event: { action: "wssessioncount", userid, count } }).
Requests temporary authenticated cookie strings for web relay sessions (desktop, terminal, files).
Returns cookie and rcookie. Does NOT return responseid or tag.
Triggers power actions: 2=Power off, 3=Reset, 4=Power sleep, 302=AMT Power On, 308=AMT Reset, etc.
If responseid provided, returns { action: "poweraction", responseid, result: "ok" }. Also causes subsequent turnoff/amtpoweraction events.
Sends Wake-On-LAN packets to target device MAC addresses. Triggers turnon event.
Returned ONLY on single-device error conditions (Invalid nodeid, No known MAC addresses). On success, confirmation arrives via turnon event!
Executes commands on target nodes. type: 0=Windows cmd/Linux sh, 2=PowerShell. Output comes back asynchronously via action:msg, type:console.
Confirms dispatch of command with result: "OK" or error string.
Displays desktop pop-up notification toast to end user on target machines.
Returns result: "OK" or error description with echoed responseid.
Exports full device details (hardware, BIOS, BitLocker, antivirus, TPM). type: "csv" or "json".
Returns data and type. Does NOT return responseid or tag.
Creates new user account. Triggers follow-up accountcreate event.
Returns result: "OK", userid, and echoed responseid.
Edits user account properties. Triggers follow-up accountchange event.
Returns result: "OK" with echoed responseid.
Deletes user account. Triggers follow-up accountremove event.
Returns result: "OK" with echoed responseid.
Creates new device group. Triggers follow-up createmesh event.
Returns result: "OK", meshid, and echoed responseid.
Deletes device group and all nodes within it. Triggers follow-up deletemesh event.
Returns result: "OK" with echoed responseid.
Changes device group name, description, consent, or flags. Triggers follow-up meshchange event.
Returns result: "OK" with echoed responseid.
Creates new user group. Triggers follow-up createusergroup event.
Returns result: "OK", ugrpid, and echoed responseid.
Deletes user group. Triggers follow-up deleteusergroup event.
Returns result: "OK" with echoed responseid.

Updates user notification bitmask for a device group: 2=WebConnect, 4=WebDisconnect, 8=WebDesktop/KVM, 16=EmailConnect, 32=EmailDisconnect, 64=EmailHelp, 128=MsgConnect, 256=MsgDisconnect, 512=MsgHelp. Triggers accountchange event.
Updates user notification bitmask override for a specific device. Triggers accountchange event.
Direct notification push to web client. Displays pop-up notification toast with title, value, titleid, msgid, args, icon, and maxtime auto-dismiss seconds.
Notification delivered inside an event wrapper { action: "event", event: { action: "notify", value, title, icon, maxtime } }.
Carries live CPU and RAM consumption stats from MeshAgent to Device Details tab.
Standard output / error streams from agent console or runcommands routed to user session.
Client requests remote clipboard with tag (1=dialog, 2=manual in, 3=auto-poll); agent returns clipboard data text.
Client sets clipboard text on remote node; agent responds with { success: true/false }.
Instructs agent to establish relay tunnel for protocol p (1=terminal, 2=desktop, 4=registry, 5=files).
Process list snapshot from remote agent.
OS system services list from remote agent.
Detailed service properties for a specific service.
Detailed process metadata (memory, start time, domain, command line, user).
Enumerates logged-in OS desktop sessions on remote machine for desktop multiplex connection selection.
Pushed when device connection or power state changes. Updates node.conn (1=agent, 2=cira, 4=amt, 16=mqtt) and node.pwr.
Pushed when new device is enrolled into a device group.
Pushed when device is deleted or removed from a device group.
Pushed when device metadata, IP, icon, or description changes.
Pushed when a device is moved from one device group to another.
Pushed when active remote control sessions on a node start or stop.
Pushed when device hardware sysinfo hash changes, prompting client to re-fetch system info if inspecting the device.
Pushed when network interface IP or MAC changes on a device.
Help request triggered from MeshAgent UI by end user. msgArgs[0]=username, msgArgs[1]=help details/reason. Web client pops up Help Request notification.
Audit log record of remote relay connection starting or stopping.
Pushed when session recording completes and MCREC file is written.
Pushed to all administrators when a new device group is created.
Pushed when device group properties or user permissions over the group change.
Pushed when a device group is deleted.
Pushed to site administrators when a user account is created.
Pushed when account settings, password, 2FA, or group links change.
Pushed when an account is removed.
Pushed on user login.
Synchronizes client UI state (nightMode, sort, showRealNames, stars) across tabs/sessions.
Sent by server immediately before closing WebSocket. Carries cause and msg (e.g. cause: "noauth", msg: "tokenrequired"). Prohibits auto-reconnect without re-auth when unauthenticated.
Client requests orderly WebSocket disconnection.
Fatal terminal message. Triggered by server stop, admin force disconnect, or session limit reached. Displays blocking Stop dialog; automatic reconnection prohibited until page refresh.
Control channel keepalive ping.
Control channel keepalive pong response.
